intelligence_evolution.summary: A 20-day stretch in which no CLU session output reached main. The Signal Engine stopped producing fresh matrices on main (perpetual SAFE MODE) and session commits accumulated on isolated feature branches that never merged, so the live site and the between-session fractional monitor both froze at the 06-30 state. The only market action was an automated INTC stop-out on 07-07 (@ $109, ~-15%, gapped through its stop), reconciled here after the fact.
intelligence_evolution.key_insight: The framework's discipline held (SAFE MODE correctly blocked all entries on a stale tape; the fractional stop still fired on INTC), but the DELIVERY pipeline is the single point of failure. No amount of signal quality matters if session outputs never merge to main and the engine never refreshes there.
